MD-S003-R0023.exact_requirement: Historical_Replay_and_Data_Quality_Backtest.md:50, 'Per-run evidence': Record replay mode, fixture/manifest hash, requested/effective dates, knowledge cutoff, all frozen revision/snapshot IDs, expected/actual readiness and reason sets, field-level mismatch paths, artifact/manifest/seal hashes, executable build identity, and PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED.
MD-S003-R0023.applicability_and_mode_scope: MANDATORY, both replay modes. The knowledge cutoff is an AS_KNOWN item; a PUBLICATION_EXACT result records it null by design (pinned to an immutable publication, not a moment of knowledge).
MD-S003-R0023.implementation_path: ReplayVerificationService::verifyRunAgainstFixture()/verifyAsKnownAgainstFixture() -> ReplayResultRepository::upsertMetric() -> md_replay_daily_metrics -> EodEvidenceRepository::findReplayMetric() -> MarketDataEvidenceExportService::exportReplayEvidence() (replay_result.json bound_inputs block plus top-level fields).
MD-S003-R0023.old_proof_problem: B18ReplayEvidenceSelfExplanationTest exports a hand-built metric (failedMetric()) through a mocked EodEvidenceRepository. The row is typed by the test, so the guard cannot fail if the real writer stops recording an identity, records a constant, or reads today's environment. Confirmed by probe: with the real writer no longer persisting event_factor_hash, that guard stayed 14/14 GREEN.
MD-S003-R0023.classification: PROOF_GUARD_GAP. The prior reconstruction suggested REBIND_ONLY; corrected from the repository, because no existing guard drove the real writer and one had to be added. No implementation defect: every new guard passed unmutated on its first run.

MD-S004-R0004.exact_requirement: Point_In_Time_Backtest_Input_Contract_LOCKED.md:15, 'Required input identity': Every row/export binds listing identity, requested/effective trade date, knowledge cutoff, as-known replay ID/publication-like artifact ID, read-model version, full config hash, factor/formula versions, and lineage. Availability timestamp is distinct from market trade date.
MD-S004-R0004.applicability_and_mode_scope: MANDATORY, both replay modes; the cutoff is as-known only and the publication id is publication only.
MD-S004-R0004.listing_identity_decision: Authority reads at two granularities ('row/export'; 'Symbol changes/reuse use listing IDs'). Both are proven, and neither substitutes for the other: the export binds the universe identity (temporal_identity_hash) and every row of the exported as-known dataset (universe rows, normalized source rows, factor rows) names its own listing_id. Proving the superset chooses no semantics: it is satisfied under either reading of the slash. Publication-mode exports carry no per-row dataset, so only the export-level identity applies there.
MD-S004-R0004.factor_vs_formula: Distinct bindings. Factor identity: event_factor_hash (event revisions, source-scale assessments, factor decisions, factor_set_hash, ancillary contamination), the per-row factor_set_id/listing_id of exported factor rows, and the lineage factor_set_hash. Formula identity: formula_registry_hash. The old binding mapped 'factor/formula versions' to formula_registry_hash only, so factor identity was never asserted.
MD-S004-R0004.lineage: Authority enumerates no lineage fields. This proof holds the repository's existing operational definition -- the verifier's lineage block (actual_lineage: run/publication/correction ids, artifact batch hashes, price-product and factor-set identity), the block REPLAY_LINEAGE_MISMATCH is raised over -- and invents no lineage field. The old 'lineage' binding (publication_artifact_lineage) is a three-key structure that is non-empty even when every value is null, so its presence check was vacuous; it is replaced by content assertions on actual_lineage. This is recorded as an authority under-specification that does not block the claim: nothing was chosen, and a richer lineage definition, if ever wanted, is a separate owner decision.
MD-S004-R0004.implementation_path: same writer/export path as MD-S003-R0023; as-known rows are the bound snapshot carried in bound_input_context_json (AsKnownReplaySnapshotService::capture()).
MD-S004-R0004.old_proof_problem: (1) listing identity mapped to the run-level hash alone; per-row listing_id never asserted. (2) factor identity never mapped or asserted. (3) lineage checked for presence only. (4) hand-built metric through a mocked repository, as for R0023. The prior reconstruction said production already carried the per-row listing_id: verified true (universe rows, source rows and factor rows all carry it in the persisted and exported as-known context).
MD-S004-R0004.classification: PROOF_GUARD_GAP. No implementation defect: production already carried every binding.
